scope: Selective upstream changes for Intel XeFG R5; preserve R4 quality profile and maximum 6x. This review records source decisions, not gameplay validation.

donor.status: Still newest donor head at review time

official_latest.head: 44cfee4d436857742a9bf71bbe81396ec9989715
official_latest.decision: Keep pinned donor plus reviewed patches; do not replace the complete runtime with latest nightly.

intel_runtime.decision: Retain R4 Intel runtime files; current release improvements are already in the existing versions.

release_facts.changes: Updates XeLL to 1.3.2.10: non-Intel leak when Present stops while markers continue; Streamline proxy handling; sleep-mode interval units.
FG fixes tight-alignment crashes and FPS-limit lowering after ResizeBuffers or interpolation-count changes.

intel_runtime.verification: R4 package SHA256 and PE version metadata checked locally. Release status checked through GitHub API; no fresh SDK archive byte comparison was performed in this review.

decisions.title: Disable XeFG backbuffer release hack
decisions.reason: R4 still contains both repeated backbuffer Release loops in FG_Hooks ResizeBuffers/1. Official commit disables these ownership-violating forced decrements. No new shader, quality profile or FG implementation.

decisions.title: Applied Dx11 like lock for XeFG on Dx12
decisions.reason: Shared resizeLock scopes do not span actual native Present/Resize calls; helper retains5000ms waits and callers continue on failure. Review concept under R5 redesign only; do not reintroduce repeated stalls.

decisions.title: Factor out FGPreserveSwapChain handling into common code
decisions.reason: Commonizes duplicate FGPreserveSwapChain logic without solving pending-command observer/recovery; broad backend interface changes. It also keeps forced real swapchain Release until0. R4 added ReleaseSwapchain failure check would need preservation.

decisions.title: Fix active Streamline binding and resource view cleanup [#1157]
decisions.reason: Active Opti Streamline proxy binding pertains to own DLSSG output, not user game Streamline input feeding XeFG. Graphics view changes are separate depth-plane helper fix not established cause of current stalls.

decisions.title: Removed JustTrackCmdList and hooks needed for it
decisions.reason: Removes old HUDfix JustTrackCmdList feature through broad resource tracker refactor. Not R4 pending submission state tracking. Avoid enabling broad HUDfix tracking just to observe queue/reset.

decisions.title: Latest official head / reprojection merge series
decisions.reason: Sep25/26 merge series adds reprojection/shaders/input camera pipeline and known AL2-disabled/multiple inflight camera artifacts; extra feature outside Intel-only stability task.

integration_notes: Apply the behavior of 349176128f5ce87fb81a4c636569c60c44557fec to both ResizeBuffers variants: remove forced borrowed-backbuffer Release loops. Do not claim the entire commit series was cherry-picked.
Queue Execute and command-list Reset observers must work for Streamline DLSSG input without enabling unrelated HUDfix capture or broad resource tracking.
Do not alter upscale ratio, AMD upscaler binary, HDR/color/exposure defaults, MFG unlock signature checks, or the maximum 6x setting as part of upstream adoption.
The latest reprojection series documents AL2-disabled and multiple-inflight camera artifacts. Its shaders and input pipeline are outside this stability task.
